excluded_paper_components: The paper's portfolio-selection experiment has multidimensional arm-specific contexts and rewards; this runtime example uses one L1 imbalance context shared across three unit-position arms and synthetic rewards.

A decision fills on the next tick. Online reward is computed from the mid-price change over an interval in which the arm was actually held; it omits execution fees, financing, opportunity cost and a portfolio reward model.
The implementation uses the paper's exact scalar normal-gamma posterior update and sampled mean-variance criterion, but does not reproduce its regret bound or empirical portfolio results.

steps.adaptation: The paper's portfolio-selection experiment has multidimensional arm-specific contexts and rewards; this runtime example uses one L1 imbalance context shared across three unit-position arms and synthetic rewards.
steps.paper_rule: For disjoint arms under a Gaussian likelihood, update normal-gamma A, b, C and D posterior parameters after observed rewards.
steps.runtime_rule: Update the selected arm's one-dimensional normal-gamma posterior from realized rewards.

steps.adaptation: The paper's portfolio-selection experiment has multidimensional arm-specific contexts and rewards; this runtime example uses one L1 imbalance context shared across three unit-position arms and synthetic rewards.
steps.paper_rule: Sample an arm's precision and mean, then maximize sampled contextual mean minus risk tolerance times sampled variance.
steps.runtime_rule: Sample precision and mean for each arm, then subtract the declared variance-risk penalty.

steps.adaptation: A decision fills on the next tick. Online reward is computed from the mid-price change over an interval in which the arm was actually held; it omits execution fees, financing, opportunity cost and a portfolio reward model.
steps.paper_rule: The contextual bandit learns from rewards of selected arms over successive rounds.
steps.runtime_rule: Observe the next price interval before updating only the arm actually held during that interval.
